# EasyTier third-party notice

`dsh-collab` can download and run the unmodified headless `easytier-core` program as a separate, replaceable process. EasyTier is not part of `dsh-collab`, and no EasyTier binary or source build output is stored in this Git repository.

The approved MVP release is:

- Project: EasyTier
- Version: `v2.6.4`
- Source commit: `8428a89d2dabc94c97d370ec607c6ca142473626`
- Upstream repository: <https://github.com/EasyTier/EasyTier>
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License version 3
- Copyright: EasyTier contributors

The official Windows x86_64 release archive is cached without modification. The runtime integration uses only the headless `easytier-core.exe`; it does not launch EasyTier GUI applications. EasyTier and its contributors do not endorse or provide support for `dsh-collab`.

The complete LGPL-3.0 and incorporated GPL-3.0 terms are included beside this notice. Exact corresponding-source and build information is in `SOURCE.md`.
